tier_note: Promotion pyramid (Hive protocol v3.2.0): working (drafting rounds) -> row 1 READY TO SEND (consensus) -> row 2 DEFINITELY READY TO SEND (final three-hat) -> row 3 GMAIL DRAFT (Tab creates the in-thread Gmail draft only after DEFINITELY READY TO SEND; the project owner reviews and sends) -> row 4 WAYBACK (sent, archived on email. and wayback.). Set by work/watch/hive_tier.py from the HubSpot subject; gmail_draft_id / sent_at / archive_url kept once set.
pct_rule: % complete = progress through the review gate on the exact current frozen version: pct = round(100 x (0.7 x min(version_reviews,10)/10 + 0.3 x min(version_distinct_agents,4)/4)). version_reviews / version_distinct_agents / version_agents are counted from each HubSpot task's signed changelog (material reviews of the current version only; creation, skips, routes and restores are not reviews; a signed version_reviews=N tally in the changelog is honoured when higher). Capped at 95 until the task is READY TO SEND or later AND its Gmail draft exists (gmail_draft_id); then 100 = in the owner's Gmail, ready to send or schedule. SENT rows show Sent. Historical reviews/distinct_agents/agents are informational only. Promotion gates beyond IN REVIEW (open_issues=0, seat_agreements_version, final_three_hat_version, attachments_verified_version equal to version) still fail closed.
purged_note: Drafts whose HubSpot task was archived under Sion's 26 Oct rule (HubSpot email tasks = FOI/case + website pitches to incorporated companies not already in talks; nothing else). Metadata only.

gate_note.rule: Gate B for routine drafts (FOI/EIR/SAR requests, chasers, acknowledgements, archive enquiries): READY needs 3 material reviews from 2 distinct agents on the exact frozen version. Escalations (ICO, PSOW, IOPC, ICR, ombudsman, legal or preservation notices) keep the full gate: 10 reviews from 4 distinct agents. Self-review rule unchanged: a seat never reviews its own version. Only Tab creates the one Gmail draft after the gate passes; the owner alone sends.
